description: This file defines the interface CKEditor5PluginManagerInterface for managing CKEditor 5 plugins within Drupal, including methods for retrieving plugins, toolbar items, libraries, plugin configurations, and supported elements.

classes.name: CKEditor5PluginManagerInterface
classes.description: Interface for managing CKEditor 5 plugins in Drupal, providing methods to retrieve plugins, toolbar items, libraries, plugin configurations, and supported elements.

methods.name: getPlugin
methods.description: Returns a CKEditor 5 plugin instance with configuration from the specified editor.

methods.name: getToolbarItems
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all toolbar items provided by plugins.

methods.name: getAdminLibraries
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all admin library names provided by plugins.

methods.name: getEnabledLibraries
methods.description: Gets a list of libraries required for the editor, filtered by enabled plugins.

methods.name: getEnabledDefinitions
methods.description: Filters plugin definitions by enabled plugins only.

methods.name: findPluginSupportingElement
methods.description: Searches for a CKEditor 5 plugin supporting a given HTML tag.

methods.name: getCKEditor5PluginConfig
methods.description: Retrieves configuration for enabled CKEditor 5 plugins in the editor.

methods.name: getProvidedElements
methods.description: Gets all supported elements for specified plugins and editor, with options for wildcards and creatable elements.
